project_type: Electron desktop app (CS2/CSGO account checker), main + preload + renderer processes
build_system: npm; electron-builder for packaging. No Dockerfile.
test_framework: node:test (built-in), run via `node --test "test/**/*.test.js"`. 133 tests currently pass.
build_command: npm run package  (electron-builder --dir; Linux target builds dist/linux-unpacked; Windows target fails only for missing wine, which is expected and NOT a regression)
verification_instructions: 1) `npm test` must show >=133 pass, 0 fail (add tests for each fix, so count should grow). 2) `npm run lint` must be clean (eslint .). 3) `node --check` on each edited .js file. 4) `npm run package` (Linux --dir) builds dist/linux-unpacked. 5) `npm audit` must stay 0 vulnerabilities. Nothing is 'fixed' until its tests pass.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. dist/ is build output only.
setup_instructions: Dependencies already installed in node_modules. Node v22, OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No install needed but `npm ci` is safe if node_modules is missing.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET available. Renderer files (html/js/front.js, html/js/rankFormat.js) and html/*.html have NO GUI test harness (no display in sandbox). Verify renderer changes with node --check + eslint + reasoning + extracted-pure-helper unit tests, NOT runtime UI. main.js Electron wiring is likewise not runtime-testable in the sandbox. EncryptedStorage.js and helpers/*.js ARE unit-tested and easy to add tests for.
contribution_requirements: Stay on branch feat/port-steam-account-manager-improvements. Do NOT create new branches, reset, or force-push. Do NOT push or open PRs (orchestrator does that). Commit incrementally with clear messages. Do NOT disable eslint/Sonar rules or add nosonar to fake compliance. Do NOT revert prior fixes: showdown->markdown-it, XP-constant false-positive handling, cyclomatic-complexity refactors, file-length reductions, steam_name->steam-name, README H1 img, unnecessary-block cleanups, markdown/XSS+XP/GC/rank tests, AES-GCM migration. Goal is NOT '0 warnings at any cost' - it is a maximally safe/stable/maintainable CS2 checker with NO behavior change beyond the security fix.
key_patterns: SECURITY posture already strong: contextIsolation:true, sandbox:false (intentional - preload needs Node), no nodeIntegration, applyNavigationGuards (will-navigate + setWindowOpenHandler deny + shell.openExternal http/https only) applied to ALL windows via wirePromptWindowCommon. Changelog innerHTML goes through markdown-it html:false (XSS-safe, helpers/markdown.js). EncryptedStorage is authenticated AES-256-GCM with legacy-CBC read + upgrade-on-save, never-write-on-decrypt-error. protoDecode/protoEncode in helpers/util.js are defensive (return {}/Buffer.alloc(0) on bad input). GC handlers guard Array.isArray/null. Renderer uses innerText for account name / level / ban cells (safe). HARD INVARIANTS that must NOT regress: rank state (expired mm/wg/dz rank==0 && wins>=10; premier rank_premier===-1), VAC cascade, GCPD gap-filler never clobbers -1, XP (cur_xp-327680000)%5000, GC message-ID/field semantics, front.js wins_dz image-bare vs `?? 0` title asymmetry + DOM write order.

These strings come from helpers/gcpd_parser.js extractCompetitiveMaps, which parses external Steam GCPD HTML via regex `([^<]+)` (name) and `([^<]*)` (skill_group).
